entities.summary: Rayalaseema is a geographic region in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh. It comprises nine southern districts of the State, namely Kurnool, Anantapur, Kadapa, Chittoor, Sri Sathya Sai, Nandyal, Annamayya, Tirupati, Markapuram. As of 2011 census of India, the region had a population of 15,184,908 and cover an area of 81,234 km2 (31,365 mi2).
